Clients
Type a new password next to a name and click Set password. Give the new password to that person. Click Edit to change someone's information.
Dispatchers
Only the people listed here can sign in on the Dispatcher tab, with the password you give them. Until you add the first dispatcher, the Dispatcher tab stays open like before. Remember to add yourself too.
Rates
Starting numbers for new truck builds, the Book a Truck rate estimate and carrier pay. The dispatcher can still adjust a single load on the build screen. Loads already built keep the prices they were saved with.
Line haul rate per mile
Truck MPG (used for the fuel surcharge)
Diesel base (one per equipment — the build screen uses the one for the truck you pick)
Fuel and margin
Company contact (shows under Contact us on the home page and on every Bill of Lading — leave blank to hide)
Managers
Add a manager and check what they're allowed to do. Managers sign in from the Manager tab on the home page and only see the areas you check. The Admins and Managers tabs are always yours only.
Owner login (red truck)
Change the login name or password for your red truck. Your current password is required.
Admins
You (the page owner) open Admin with your owner login. Add other people here if they need it, and remove them any time. Only the owner can see this box.
Directory
Add companies and contacts by hand. Click Edit to update an entry or Remove to delete it.
Freight zones
Zones go by driving miles from Pender Nursery. Change any zone here when costs change. Only the owner can edit these; every rep's Freight quote calculator uses them right away after you save.
Completed loads archive
Completed loads move here at the end of the month. A week that runs into a new month counts under the new month (the month its Friday falls in). Their orders leave the Pender workbook and the Delivery Trucks tab at the same time. Nothing is deleted.
